description: For any total \(g:X\to\mathbb N\) and \(h:X\to\mathbb N\to\mathbb N\to\mathbb N\), exactly one total function satisfies the starting and recursion equations.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.recValue_unique.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} (g : α → ℕ) (h : α → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) :
  ∃! F, (∀ (x : α), F x 0 = g x) ∧ ∀ (x : α) (n : ℕ), F x (n + 1) = h x n (F x n)
